funds.name: 食の未来1号投資事業有限責任組合 (Food Future Fund No. 1)

strategy.thesis: Self-described as Japan's first domestic VC fund focused on agri-/foodtech, backing alternative proteins, cellular agriculture, vertical farming, food-waste and agritech startups.

summary.en: kemuri ventures (est. as an LLC in May 2020, reorganized into a kabushiki kaisha via merger in March 2025) runs '食の未来1号' (Food Future Fund No. 1, formed October 2020), described on its site as the first agri-/foodtech-specialized fund among Japanese domestic VCs. Portfolio of 20+ includes AGRIST, DAIZ, IntegriCulture, HarvestX, TOWING and Gryllus.
summary.local: kemuri ventures(2020年5月に合同会社として設立、2025年3月の合併で株式会社化)。2020年10月組成の『食の未来1号投資事業有限責任組合』は、自社サイトで国内VCとして初の『アグリ・フードテック』特化型ファンドと説明。AGRIST、DAIZ、インテグリカルチャー、HarvestX、TOWING、グリラスなど20社超に出資。

aka: フューチャーフードファンド

funds.name: Future Food Fund 1号投資事業有限責任組合
Future Food Fund 2号投資事業有限責任組合

strategy.thesis: Food-innovation-focused corporate VC of Oisix ra daichi, investing across foodtech, new food/alt-protein, agritech, food robotics, alt-seafood and kitchen/appliance tech to build a food-startup ecosystem in Japan.

summary.en: Future Food Fund is the food-innovation-focused corporate VC of Oisix ra daichi (subsidiary established August 2019). Its first fund (2019) raised reportedly ~¥2bn from 14 LP companies; by March 2022 cumulative investment reached ~¥900M across 15 companies. A 2nd fund was formed in 2023. Portfolio spans agritech (inaho), alt-seafood (Impact Food), land-based aquaculture (ARK) and US cultivated seafood (Cultured Decadence).
summary.local: オイシックス・ラ・大地のフードイノベーション特化型CVC(運営子会社は2019年8月設立)。1号ファンド(2019年)は14社のLPから出資を集め(報道では約20億円規模)、2022年3月時点で累計約9億円・15社へ投資。2023年に2号ファンドを組成。inaho、Impact Food、ARK、Cultured Decadenceなどに出資。

name.en: The Agribusiness Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
name.local: アグリビジネス投資育成株式会社

funds.name: SFVC ファンド (食のバリューチェーン全体対象)

strategy.thesis: Established under the 2002 special-measures law to facilitate investment in agricultural corporations; takes equity in agricultural/forestry/fishery corporations and the broader food value chain (food-industry and support companies), including overseas firms aiding Japanese food/agri exports.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the 農業法人投資育成制度 framework through partner JA / Japan Finance Corporation channels

summary.en: ABIC (founded October 2002 by the JA Group and Japan Finance Corporation under a special-measures law on investment in agricultural corporations) takes equity in agriculture/forestry/fishery corporations and food value-chain companies. Main shareholders include Norinchukin Bank (38.10%), JA Zen-Noh (10.10%), JA Zenkyoren (10.10%). As of end-July 2019 it had a cumulative 560+ investments totaling over ¥9.1 billion — reportedly the largest by count domestically. Set up an SFVC fund in February 2022.
summary.local: アグリビジネス投資育成株式会社(ABIC)は、2002年施行の農業法人投資円滑化特措法に基づきJAグループと日本政策金融公庫の出資で2002年10月設立。農林漁業法人や食のバリューチェーン企業に出資。主要株主は農林中央金庫38.10%、JA全農10.10%、JA全共連10.10%。2019年7月末で累積投資560件超・累計91億円超(件数では国内最大規模)。2022年2月にSFVCファンドを設定。

name.local: 株式会社SDGインパクトジャパン

strategy.thesis: Operates the AgFunder SIJ Impact Fund jointly with Singapore's AgFunder Asia, investing in agri-/foodtech startups (cultured meat, plant-based/fermentation, robotics+AI farm management, IoT sensing) with priority for Japan-connected ventures and sustainability impact.

summary.en: SDG Impact Japan (SIJ), a sustainable-finance house founded 2021 and co-led by Mari Kogiso and Bradley Busetto, co-operates the AgFunder SIJ Impact Fund with Singapore's AgFunder Asia. The fund had its first close in March 2022 at ¥1 billion (from Meiji Holdings and Asahi Group Holdings) with a projected ¥3–5 billion final close; LPs also include Kewpie, Nakashimato and Fuyo General Lease. It invests in agri-/foodtech with a sustainability/impact lens.
summary.local: 株式会社SDGインパクトジャパン(SIJ、2021年設立、共同代表 小木曽麻里・ブラッドリー・ブセット)は、シンガポールのAgFunder Asiaと共同で『AgFunder SIJ Impact Fund』を運営。2022年3月に明治HD・アサヒGHDから総額10億円で初回クローズ、最終3〜50億円規模を見込む。LPにキユーピー、中島董商店、芙蓉総合リースなど。アグリ・フードテックにインパクト投資。

funds.name: 農林中金戦略協創1号投資事業有限責任組合 (NSCF)

strategy.thesis: Wholly-owned PE/VC management arm of Norinchukin Bank; via the strategic co-creation fund (NSCF, est. May 2023) it backs seed/early-stage startups solving food (食), agriculture (農) and living (くらし) challenges, leveraging the JA/JF/JForest groups and AgVenture Lab.

summary.en: Norinchukin Capital (established August 2021 by spinning out Norinchukin Bank's direct-investment team; began fund management October 2021) runs growth/buyout funds plus CVC funds focused on Agritech, Foodtech, Fintech, Lifetech and regional revitalization at seed/early stage. Its strategic co-creation fund 'NSCF' (農林中金戦略協創1号, established May 2023) targets startups in food, agriculture and living, working with AgVenture Lab and the JA/JF/JForest groups; investments include UK biodiversity-data firm Natcap.
summary.local: 農林中金キャピタル(農林中央金庫の直接投資チームが移籍し2021年8月設立、2021年10月運用開始)。グロース/バイアウト型に加え、国内外シード・アーリーのAgritech・Foodtech・Fintech・Lifetech・地方創生に投資するCVCファンドを運用。戦略協創ファンド『NSCF(農林中金戦略協創1号)』は2023年5月設立で、食・農・くらしの課題解決スタートアップに投資。AgVenture LabやJA/JF/JForestグループと連携。Natcap等に出資。

geo_focus: Japan (Iwate Prefecture / Iwate Bank operating area)
strategy.thesis: Regional bank VC (Iwate Bank group) whose dedicated Agricultural Corporation Fund injects equity into certified-farmer agricultural corporations in Iwate to strengthen their capital base and management.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via Iwate Bank / Iwagin Business Creation Capital; eligibility limited to certified agricultural corporations in Iwate Bank's operating area

summary.en: Iwagin Business Creation Capital (founded 2015, a regional VC of the Iwate Bank group, Morioka) runs the dedicated 'Iwagin Agricultural Corporation Fund' (いわぎん農業法人投資事業有限責任組合), a ¥500 million LPS with Iwate Bank and Japan Finance Corporation as members. It invests equity in certified (or soon-to-be-certified) agricultural corporations within Iwate Bank's operating area to strengthen their capital base — a rare regionally-dedicated agri investor.
summary.local: いわぎん事業創造キャピタル(2015年設立、岩手銀行グループの地域VC、盛岡)。専用ファンド『いわぎん農業法人投資事業有限責任組合』(組合規模5億円、組合員は岩手銀行・日本政策金融公庫)を運営。岩手銀行営業エリア内の認定農業者(またはそれが確実な)農業法人へ出資し、経営基盤強化を支援する。地域特化の数少ない農業投資家。

summary.en: The Tohoku Bank / Morishin Agri Fund (No. 1 established 2019; No. 2 established 2025) is a regional agriculture-dedicated equity fund investing in agriculture/forestry/fishery and food-industry corporations within the Tohoku region. The 2025 successor fund targets three themes: smart-agriculture, decarbonized-agriculture, and agricultural succession/M&A. Disclosed portfolio includes Agri-ed Iwate, Hachinohe Winery, Green Power Tono and Akafusa Foods.

name.en: Agriculture, forestry and fisheries Fund corporation for Innovation, Value-chain and Expansion Japan
name.local: 株式会社農林漁業成長産業化支援機構

size.raw: 51 sub-funds approved totaling ¥743.02B (A-FIVE contribution ¥371.51B), as of Dec 2014

strategy.thesis: Public-private fund (METI/MAFF) set up for a 20-year limited life to support 6th-industrialization (六次産業化) ventures where primary-industry agri/forestry/fishery operators integrate with secondary/tertiary players, mainly via regional sub-funds.

application.how_to_apply: Not accepting new investment inquiries (new investments ended); only provides management support to existing portfolio

summary.en: A-FIVE (Agriculture, forestry and fisheries Fund corporation for Innovation, Value-chain and Expansion Japan), established November 2013 as a 20-year time-limited public-private fund, supported 6th-industrialization ventures combining primary agri/forestry/fishery operators with secondary/tertiary partners, mainly through regional sub-funds with local banks (51 sub-funds totaling ¥743.02B approved by end-2014, A-FIVE share ¥371.51B). It has since ended new investments and only supports existing portfolio companies — included as a dormant but distinctly agri-food investor.
summary.local: 株式会社農林漁業成長産業化支援機構(A-FIVE)は、2013年11月設立の存続20年の官民ファンド。一次産業者と2次・3次産業者が連携する6次産業化事業体を、地域金融機関と組成するサブファンドを通じて支援。2014年末で51サブファンド(総額7,430.2億円、A-FIVE出資3,715.1億円)を承認。現在は新規投資を終了し既存先の経営支援のみ。
